# Evelyn Sorochan-Ruland

Evelyn Sorochan-Ruland is an interdisciplinary visual artist living and working in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. Her work sits between painting and sculpture.

Canonical site: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/

## Pages

- Home: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/
- About: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/about.html
- Curriculum vitae: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/cv.html
- Contact: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/contact.html
- Foothold, 2022 solo exhibition at Gallery Stratford, Stratford, Ontario: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/foothold.html
- Groundwork, mixed media from 2021, supported by the London Arts Council: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/groundwork.html
- Reclaim, mixed media installations from 2020 and 2021: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/reclaim.html
- Industrial Skins, 2018 solo exhibition at the Audain Gallery, Victoria, British Columbia: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/industrial_skins.html
- Touchline, mixed media from 2017 and 2018: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/touchline.html
- Abstract Reliefs, mixed media from 2016 and 2017: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/abstractreliefs.html
- Overtake, works from 2013 to 2015: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/overtake.html
- Anthem, exhibited in 2015 at Project Space Gallery, Boarding House, Guelph, Ontario: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/anthem.html
- The Awkward Truce, 2014 exhibition with Brody Johnston at Zavitz Gallery, University of Guelph: https://evelynsorochanruland.com/awkward_truce.html
